title: How football can change a child’s life.
author: Emma
body:
Blue Dragon Children’s Foundation have rescued over 1,000 people from slavery, helped 6,000 kids back to school and assisted more than 600 homeless children reunite with their families. But there is another figure that is equally important for Blue Dragon and that’s having played over 3,000 football games with local children in the streets of Vietnam.

Football has been a large part of the organisation from the beginning.

Nam was one of these kids who came to Blue Dragon in the organisations early days. He didn’t want help going back to school because he needed money to support his mother and younger brothers in the countryside. Blue Dragon learnt of his passion for football and invited him to weekly games.

After a year of participating in football games, Nam trusted the organisation to seek for help. He needed help finding a job as money was a priority to his family, Blue Dragon understood and introduced him to Donald Berger, one of Hanoi’s best restaurateurs. Nam’s life changed forever.

Nam is now an award-winning chef who worked part time at Blue Dragon for many years, but now finds himself as head chef for a company with seven restaurants. It is astonishing how a weekly football game was able to positively impact Nam’s life.

If you’d like to help children like Nam, please donate to Blue Dragon Children’s Foundation today. OneTomorrow is a proud supporter of the organisation and is committee to doubling each donation received. Please click the donation link here.
